records.title_zh: 转动以后还是同一个图形吗
records.title_en: Is it still the same shape after rotation?
records.purpose: Classify shapes from defining properties rather than prototype orientation.
records.setup: Show a square upright and rotated 45°.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 转动后它还是正方形吗？不要说‘看起来像不像’，说哪些性质没有变。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Is it still a square after being rotated? Do not rely on appearance; state which properties stayed unchanged.
records.expected_thinking: Rotation preserves four equal sides and four right angles.
records.listen_for: Calling the rotated square a different category because of orientation.
records.variation: Rotate rectangles, triangles and other polygons.

records.title_en: Visible features are not all the features
records.purpose: Reason about faces, edges and vertices of a solid rather than a 2D drawing only.
records.setup: Cube or cuboid plus a perspective drawing.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 先在实体上数面、棱、顶点，再看二维图。图上哪些部分看不见？为什么仍然存在？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Count faces, edges and vertices on the solid first. Then look at the drawing. Which features are hidden in the drawing but still exist?
records.expected_thinking: A 2D representation may hide features; the solid's structure determines the full count.
records.listen_for: Counting only visible edges/vertices in the drawing.

records.title_zh: 一个图形可以属于多个类别
records.title_en: A shape can belong to more than one category
records.setup: Use square, rectangle, rhombus, parallelogram and trapezium/trapezoid according to local definitions.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 正方形可以同时属于哪些类别？每一个类别用定义说明。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which categories can a square belong to at the same time? Justify each category from its definition.
records.expected_thinking: A square satisfies broader quadrilateral categories while also having additional properties.
records.listen_for: Treating all shape names as mutually exclusive.
records.variation: Repeat with a rhombus or rectangle.

records.title_zh: 关系不取决于纸面方向
records.title_en: Line relationships do not depend on page orientation
records.purpose: Define parallel/perpendicular relationships independent of horizontal/vertical prototypes.
records.setup: Draw sloping parallel lines and sloping perpendicular lines.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 这两条斜线为什么仍然平行？这两条斜线为什么仍然垂直？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Why are these sloping lines still parallel? Why are these sloping lines still perpendicular?
records.expected_thinking: Parallel lines remain equidistant and do not meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle regardless of orientation.
records.listen_for: Parallel means horizontal; perpendicular means one vertical and one horizontal.

records.title_zh: 按定义分类非典型四边形
records.purpose: Use properties rather than visual prototypes for classification.
records.setup: Prepare several rotated or stretched quadrilaterals.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 不要按‘像不像课本里的样子’分类。逐个检查边、角和平行关系。这个图形属于哪些类别？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Do not classify by whether it looks like the textbook example. Check sides, angles and parallel relationships. Which categories does this figure satisfy?
records.expected_thinking: Definitions determine category membership even for non-prototypical orientations/proportions.
records.listen_for: Rejecting a category because the figure is rotated or stretched.
records.variation: Ask pupils to draw an unusual example of a valid rectangle or parallelogram.

records.title_zh: 半径、直径和圆心的关系
records.purpose: Develop structural relationships within a circle.
records.setup: Circle with centre marked; strings/ruler optional.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 画三条不同方向的半径，再画一条直径。为什么所有半径一样长？为什么直径是两个半径？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Draw three radii in different directions and one diameter. Why are all radii equal? Why is a diameter two radii?
records.expected_thinking: Radii connect centre to circumference; a diameter passes through the centre and consists of two collinear radii.
records.listen_for: Calling any chord a diameter; radius and diameter used interchangeably.
records.variation: Given diameter 10 cm, find radius and explain.
records.evidence_note: Circle depth differs across primary frameworks; apply grade-resolution rules.

records.title_en: Turn first, draw the angle second
records.purpose: Establish angle as amount of turn.
records.use_when: Before formal angle classification or measurement.
records.setup: Use body turns or a movable arrow.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 从正前方向右转四分之一圈、半圈、四分之三圈。每次转了多少？把转动结果画成角。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Turn from facing forward by a quarter turn, half turn and three-quarter turn. How much did you turn each time? Represent each turn as an angle.
records.expected_thinking: Quarter, half and three-quarter turns correspond to 90°, 180° and 270°.
records.listen_for: Treating angle only as shape formed by two lines without amount-of-turn meaning.
records.variation: Predict turn needed between two clock-hand positions.

records.title_en: Arm length does not determine angle size
records.purpose: Separate angle size from length of drawn arms.
records.setup: Draw two equal angles with different arm lengths.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 哪个角更大？如果边画得更长，角会变大吗？你怎样验证？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which angle is larger? Does making the arms longer make the angle larger? How could you verify?
records.expected_thinking: Angle size is determined by rotation/opening, not arm length.
records.listen_for: Longer arms imply a larger angle.
records.variation: Draw a small obtuse angle and a large-looking acute angle.

records.title_zh: 转动画面不改变角的类别
records.title_en: Rotating the drawing does not change the angle type
records.purpose: Classify angles by measure rather than orientation.
records.setup: Same acute angle drawn at several orientations.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 三个角方向不同，但张开程度相同。它们属于同一类吗？用90°作基准说明。
records.teacher_prompt_en: The three angles face different directions but have the same opening. Are they the same type? Use 90° as a benchmark.
records.expected_thinking: Orientation does not affect angle measure; all remain acute if less than 90°.
records.listen_for: Classification changes when the drawing rotates.

records.purpose: Use angle magnitude to choose the correct protractor scale.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 先估这个角小于还是大于90°。量角器上有两个数字时，哪个读数合理？为什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: First estimate whether the angle is less or greater than 90°. If the protractor shows two possible readings, which one is reasonable and why?
records.expected_thinking: Magnitude estimate determines the appropriate scale reading.
records.listen_for: Reading whichever scale number is noticed first; misaligning baseline/centre.

records.purpose: Use additive angle relationships to find unknown angles.
records.use_when: Angles on lines, around points or decomposed angles.
records.setup: Draw adjacent angles on a straight line: one 128°, one unknown.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 先不用量角器。未知角是多少？你依据哪个角关系？用算式说明。
records.teacher_prompt_en: Do not use a protractor yet. What is the unknown angle? Which angle relationship justifies it? Show the equation.
records.expected_thinking: Angles on a straight line sum to 180°, so unknown=180-128=52°.
records.listen_for: Measuring despite sufficient information; no statement of the relationship.
records.variation: Use angles around a point or a triangle.
